# Error codes

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-docs.lisp from src/resources/error-codes.lisp. Do not edit. -->

Tool failures carry a `code`. Look it up here.

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `APPROVAL_EXPIRED` | Approval expired or already used | Invoke the tool again to request a new approval |
| `CLASS_NOT_FOUND` | Class not found | The class name does not exist |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Internal error | An unexpected error occurred |
| `INTERRUPT_ERROR` | Interrupt error | The thread may not be interruptible or may have already completed |
| `INVALID_BOOLEAN_PARAMETER` | approved must be a boolean or 'true'/'false' string | Provide a boolean value (t/nil) or the strings "true"/"false" |
| `INVALID_CODE_PARAMETER` | code is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide a Lisp expression as a string, e.g., :code "(+ 1 2)" |
| `INVALID_EXPRESSION_PARAMETER` | expression is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide an expression that evaluates to an object, e.g., :expression "*package*" |
| `INVALID_FILENAME_PARAMETER` | filename is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide a filename as a string, e.g., :filename "my-file" |
| `INVALID_FRAME_INDEX` | frame-index must be a non-negative integer | Provide a valid frame index starting from 0 |
| `INVALID_INTEGER_PARAMETER` | Parameter must be an integer | Ensure the parameter value is an integer |
| `INVALID_LIST_PARAMETER` | Parameter must be a list | Ensure the parameter value is a list |
| `INVALID_PACKAGE_PARAMETER` | package is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide a package name as a string, e.g., :package "CL-USER" |
| `INVALID_PREFIX_PARAMETER` | prefix is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide a symbol prefix, e.g., :prefix "mak" |
| `INVALID_STRING_PARAMETER` | Parameter must be a string | Ensure the parameter value is a string type |
| `INVALID_SYMBOL_PARAMETER` | symbol is required and must be a non-empty string | Provide a symbol name, e.g., :symbol "mapcar" |
| `JSON_PARSE_ERROR` | JSON parse error | Ensure the request is valid JSON format |
| `MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS` | Max reconnection attempts reached | Check server availability and try again later |
| `MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER` | Missing required parameter | Provide a value for this parameter |
| `NOT_A_FUNCTION` | Symbol is not a function | Provide a symbol that names a function |
| `NOT_IN_STEPPER` | Not in stepper | Enter the stepper with (step ...) first |
| `NO_DEBUGGER_EVENT` | No debugger event available | Enter the debugger first by triggering an error or using a breakpoint |
| `NREPL_NOT_SUPPORTED` | nrepl is no longer supported; use Swank | Use repl_connect :type :swank :port 4005 or start Swank: (ql:quickload :swank) (swank:create-server :port 4005) |
| `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` | Object not found | The object ID does not exist in the object registry |
| `PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND` | Package not found | The package name does not exist |
| `PARAMETER_TOO_SHORT` | Parameter must be at least minimum length | Provide a longer value for this parameter |
| `PARAMETER_TOO_SMALL` | Parameter must be >= minimum value | Provide a larger value for this parameter |
| `RECONNECTION_DISABLED` | Reconnection is disabled | Enable reconnection or manually reconnect |
| `RECONNECTION_ERROR` | Reconnection error | Check server status and network connectivity |
| `REPL_ALREADY_CONNECTED` | Already connected to a REPL | Use repl_disconnect first if you want to connect to a different server |
| `REPL_DETECTION_FAILED` | Could not detect Swank | Ensure Swank server is running on the specified port |
| `REPL_NOT_CONNECTED` | Not connected to any REPL | Run repl_connect first |
| `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` | Request not found | The request ID does not exist or has expired |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | Request timeout | The operation took too long to complete |
| `SWANK_ALREADY_CONNECTED` | Already connected to Swank server | Use swank_disconnect first if you want to connect to a different server |
| `SWANK_CONNECTION_FAILED` | Failed to connect to Swank | Ensure Swank server is running and accessible |
| `SWANK_NOT_CONNECTED` | Not connected to Swank server | Use swank_connect to establish a connection |
| `TOOL_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT` | Tool execution timeout | The tool took too long to complete |
| `UNKNOWN_METHOD` | Unknown method | Check the method name and ensure it is supported by the server |
